parameters.query:
-- Апсерт текущего снапшота + мягкое "погашение" пропавших записей.
-- Выполняется всегда (даже без изменений) чтобы БД была актуальной.
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset($2::json)
    AS x(external_id text, title text, company text, price numeric, url text, fingerprint text)
)
, upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO monitor_items (source_key, external_id, title, company, price, url, fingerprint, is_active, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, updated_at)
  SELECT $1, external_id, title, company, price, url, fingerprint, true, now(), now(), now() FROM incoming
  ON CONFLICT (source_key, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    company = EXCLUDED.company,
    price = EXCLUDED.price,
    url = EXCLUDED.url,
    fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
    is_active = true,
    last_seen_at = now(),
    updated_at = CASE WHEN monitor_items.fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.fingerprint THEN now() ELSE monitor_items.updated_at END
  RETURNING 1
)
UPDATE monitor_items m SET is_active = false, updated_at = now()
WHERE m.source_key = $1 AND m.is_active = true
  AND m.external_id NOT IN (SELECT external_id FROM incoming);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Source Config').first().json.sourceKey }},={{ JSON.stringify($('Normalize Items').all().map(i => ({ external_id: i.json.externalId, title: i.json.title, company: i.json.company, price: i.json.price, url: i.json.url, fingerprint: i.json.fingerprint }))) }}
